quotes.title: HD 30856
quotes.card: HD 30856 is a binary system between HD 30856 A, a K-type giant star, and HD 30856 B, a red dwarf companion, located in the constellation of Eridanus about 430 light-years distant.
quotes.introduction: A super-Jupiter exoplanet, HD 30856 b, is known to orbit the primary star.
